summary.en: Torrent describes R&D focused on complex generics, drug delivery and differentiated formulations, with work in metabolic disease, CNS and oncology. Its latest reviewed annual report does not identify an asset-level clinical pipeline suitable for this brief.
summary.zh: Torrent 称其研发聚焦于复杂仿制药、药物递送和差异化制剂,涉及代谢疾病、CNS 和肿瘤领域。其最新审阅的年报未列出适合本简报的资产层面临床管线。

watch.en: The FY2025–26 annual report discloses 115 development projects and R&D spending of Rs650 crore; these are not counts by clinical phase.
watch.zh: FY2025–26 年报披露了 115 个开发项目和 Rs650 crore 的研发支出;这些并非按临床阶段统计的数量。

watch.en: R&D investment includes GLP-1 formulations, oncology, immunology and neurology.
watch.zh: 研发投入包括 GLP-1 制剂、肿瘤、免疫和神经领域。

watch.en: The FY2025–26 report records Indian approvals for brexpiprazole tablets and oral semaglutide; these already approved products are excluded from pipeline items.
watch.zh: FY2025–26 年报记录了 brexpiprazole 片剂和口服 semaglutide 在印度获批;这些已获批产品不计入管线项目。

gaps: Company-wide counts by phase were not verified; counts is null. Unverified codes, mechanisms, modalities, origins and milestone dates are null rather than inferred.

No currently investigational named asset with a verified phase was found in the reviewed FY2025–26 report. Items is empty instead of assigning phases to generic projects or already approved formulations.

The latest Q2 FY27 results index loaded, but its press release timed out and the earnings transcript was inaccessible; curl fallback failed due to DNS. The annual report is the latest substantive accessible company source used here.
Historical TRC150094 records were located, but current development status and a future milestone were not verified, so the asset was omitted rather than recycling an old Phase 3 status.
The complete research-area and portfolio webpages were also reviewed; they describe therapeutic interests and formulation categories without a named current clinical-phase table.

Final curl -sSIL checks were attempted for every cited URL on 2026-11-17. All 57 unique URLs returned HTTP 000 with curl exit 6 because this environment could not resolve hosts. Browser-loaded sources support the entries, but independent HTTP-status verification could not be completed.
